title: Silence golangci-lint on non-Sequoia runs

comments.body: Wait, there’s some chance this will be changed in the linter ( https://github.com/dominikh/go-tools/issues/1736 touches related code).

… no, that’s an unrelated change. (Upstream `staticcheck` binary explicitly says
```
vendor/go.podman.io/image/v5/signature/simplesequoia/signer_stub.go:26:1: go.podman.io/image/v5/signature/simplesequoia.NewSigner never returns a nil interface value
```
so this is intentional, not a bug in the linter.)
(Updated to also include the golangci-lint upgrade, because our `osx` test seems to run with latest Go, and the linter doesn’t work if it is older.)
need to rebase this branch, do we really want to force rebases here all the time? feels like more churn than worth it
